signal.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
signal.summary: On November 10, 2026, Google Cloud announced a U.S. preview of Gemini for healthcare, an enterprise system that combines specialized healthcare skills, clinical record connectors, controlled agents and audit trails. Read integrations for Epic and Oracle Health are listed among partner capabilities. The product is aimed at providers and payers, not at replacing clinical judgment or becoming a general consumer diagnosis service.

signal.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
signal.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on November 9, 2026. The company says both use the same underlying model, while Fable applies stronger cybersecurity and biological safeguards for broad access and Mythos uses verification programs for specialized work. Anthropic advertises $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, with a higher-priced fast mode and company-run capability benchmarks.

signal.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
signal.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber on November 5, 2026 as a specialized security research model for authorized vulnerability discovery and validation. In its tests, it reports 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, and stronger adherence to assigned scope. Initial access is limited to approved Daybreak Red customers, so this is not a general ChatGPT model release.

models.positioning: Flagship GPT-5.6 tier for complex professional work, coding, research, and agentic workflows.
OpenAI's purpose-trained cybersecurity model for approved defenders conducting authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and advanced security testing.

signal.title: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
signal.summary: Microsoft introduced the Copilot harness in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service as a public preview on October 28, 2026. Teams can configure agents using reusable skills, connected tools and MCP integrations while Foundry runs the agent loop and sandbox. The preview differs from the generally available long-running resilience feature for hosted agents, and the harness has its own regional, model and billing constraints.
